title: Among members who attended more than one event and have a t-shirt size of '
question: Among members who attended more than one event and have a t-shirt size of 'Large', which member incurred the highest total expense on approved items?

prediction.sql:
SELECT m.XCL_034
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a ON m.XCL_034 = a.XCL_002
JOIN expense AS e ON m.XCL_034 = e.XCL_022
WHERE m.XCL_039 = 'Large'
  AND e.XCL_021 = 'true'
GROUP BY m.XCL_034
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_001) > 1
ORDER BY SUM(e.XCL_020) DESC
LIMIT 1
